brief.title: Diligence review
brief.reader: A reader reviewing a reusable explanation before it is filled with completed legal work.
brief.action: Use the visible structure to identify the answer, conditions, source support and next action.
brief.message: This blueprint describes the information each component should contain; it makes no matter-specific legal claim.
gaps: No matter-specific source document has been supplied.

claims.text: Name the subject and reader task.
State the supported answer and the relationship among its conditions.

Describe the fact pattern, reader question and route through the review.
